question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a green ball, Bob has a purple ball, Claire has a pink ball, Dave has a grey ball, Eve has a blue ball, Fred has a yellow ball, and Gertrude has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Bob swap balls. Then, Bob and Fred swap balls. Then, Claire and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Eve and Fred swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Eve swap balls. Finally, Eve and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) green ball
(B) purple ball
(C) pink ball
(D) grey ball
(E) blue ball
(F) yellow ball
(G) gold ball
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial ball colors: green | purple | pink | grey | blue | yellow | gold
1. Claire ↔ Bob: green | pink | purple | grey | blue | yellow | gold
2. Bob ↔ Fred: green | yellow | purple | grey | blue | pink | gold
3. Claire ↔ Gertrude: green | yellow | gold | grey | blue | pink | purple
4. Dave ↔ Bob: green | grey | gold | yellow | blue | pink | purple
5. Eve ↔ Fred: green | grey | gold | yellow | pink | blue | purple
6. Gertrude ↔ Eve: green | grey | gold | yellow | purple | blue | pink
7. Eve ↔ Claire: green | grey | purple | yellow | gold | blue | pink
Claire has the purple ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
